summary: Build crisis messaging and stakeholder engagement skills with ISO 22361, scenario exercises, templates, and practical reporting tools. Enrol today.
lede: Crisis communication training helps corporate communications managers, public affairs specialists, and business continuity leads coordinate responses as facts change. It covers stakeholder prioritization, approval roles, holding statements, message houses, spokesperson and channel coordination, and digital monitoring; scenario exercises let participants build a crisis communication plan, assess information needs, and track response performance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate crisis messaging, stakeholder information, media engagement, and organizational response communications. It suits intermediate practitioners who already handle routine communications and now need a structured approach to high-pressure incidents.
audience: Executive Assistants and Chiefs of Staff
prerequisites: You should have working experience in corporate communications, media relations, public affairs, internal communications, business continuity, incident coordination, or stakeholder engagement. No programming is required. Familiarity with organizational approval processes and digital communication channels will support the practical exercises.
